title: Review: fragment.rs security 2026-08-16
description:
Security review of rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs

Focus: injection, buffer overflow, crypto misuse, auth bypass, input validation gaps

Review confidence: 15% chance of missed bug.
Least confident areas: ACK bitmap handling state machine, window boundary transitions
Would raise confidence if: Formal verification of bitmap arithmetic, fuzz testing of from_bytes paths

Summary:
- No P0 critical security bugs found
- 1 P2 documentation gap (missing SECURITY comment on non-crypto MIC)
- 2 P3 minor issues (timing pattern, API documentation)
- 3 positive findings worth defending

The code is well-written with proper input validation. Rust memory safety prevents buffer overflows. State machine handles edge cases correctly.
